info.name: LabourSampark Admin APIs
info.description:
Comprehensive, verified Postman collection for all LabourSampark Admin Panel and administrative APIs extracted directly from the Node.js / Express backend codebase.

### Authentication
Most endpoints require Bearer JWT Authentication generated from Admin Login (`POST /api/users/login`) with `userType: 'admin'` or `'super_admin'`. Collection-level Bearer authentication is preconfigured with `{{adminToken}}`.

variable.description: Base URL of the LabourSampark backend API server
Target User ObjectId (Labour, Contractor, Sub-contractor, Admin)
Target Document ObjectId for KYC verification

request.description:
Authenticates an administrator with email/mobile and password. Generates a session-bound JWT containing `userId`, `userType` (`admin` or `super_admin`), and a rotated `sessionId`. Also available via `/auth/login`.

**Controller**: `login` in `src/controllers/userController.js`
**Auth**: Public

Logs out the authenticated administrator, sets `isLoggedIn: false`, nullifies `activeSessionId`, and stamps `lastLogoutAt`. Also available via `/auth/logout`.

**Controller**: `logout` in `src/controllers/userController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`)

Fetches current authenticated administrator's profile information.

**Controller**: `getProfile` in `src/controllers/userController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`)

Updates profile details for the logged-in administrator. Restricted fields (`_id`, `password`, `email`, `mobile`, `createdAt`) cannot be edited via this route.

**Controller**: `updateProfile` in `src/controllers/userController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`)

Allows an authenticated administrator to change their login password after validating the current password.

**Controller**: `changePassword` in `src/controllers/userController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`)

Fetches aggregated platform metrics across users, jobs, reviews, skills, inquiries, documents, payments, notifications, and job enquiries.

**Controller**: `getDashboardStats` in `src/controllers/publicController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`)

When invoked by an administrator (`userType: 'admin'` or `'super_admin'`), returns platform-wide operational statistics: totalJobs, activeJobs, completedJobs, totalApplications, totalAccepted, totalRejected, and totalUsers.

**Controller**: `getJobStats` in `src/controllers/jobStatsController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken` with Admin role)

query.description: Search term matching fullName, email, mobile, or userCode

request.description:
Retrieves all users across the platform (labour, contractor, sub_contractor, admin, super_admin) with search filtering and sorting (`createdAt: -1`). Sensitive tokens and passwords are automatically excluded. Also available via `/auth/admin/allUser`.

**Controller**: `getAllUsers` in `src/controllers/userController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

request.description:
Allows an administrator to modify any user's profile, status (`active`, `inactive`, `blocked`, `suspended`), userType (`labour`, `contractor`, `sub_contractor`, `admin`, `super_admin`), profile visibility (`display`), verification badges, and administrative notes. Also available via `/auth/admin/update/:id`.

**Controller**: `adminUpdateUser` in `src/controllers/userController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

query.description: Search keyword matching workTitle, description, city, or state

request.description:
Retrieves all jobs created on the platform with populated creator details (`fullName email mobile userType userCode companyName`), pagination, and keyword search.

**Controller**: `getAllJobsAdmin` in `src/controllers/jobController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)
**Note**: In router definition, route is defined after wildcard `/:jobId`.

Retrieves all uploaded user documents pending verification (`status: 'pending'`), sorted chronologically and populated with user profile info (`fullName email mobile`).

**Controller**: `getPendingDocuments` in `src/controllers/documentController.js`
**Auth**: Admin operations endpoint

Updates the verification status of a document. Allowed status values: `pending`, `approved`, `rejected`, `expired`. When approved, sets `verified: true` and records `verifiedAt`.

**Controller**: `updateDocumentStatus` in `src/controllers/documentController.js`
**Auth**: Admin/Verifier operations endpoint

query.description: Search by txnId, receipt, customer email, customer phone, or productInfo

request.description:
Retrieves all payments across gateways (PayU, Cashfree) with pagination, populated user details, and status-level aggregation summaries (counts and totalAmount per status).

**Controller**: `getAllPayments` in `src/controllers/paymentController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Initiates a refund via Cashfree Payment Gateway for an existing successful payment transaction.

**Controller**: `createCashfreeRefund` in `src/controllers/cashfreeController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Checks and syncs the refund status for a payment directly from Cashfree Payment Gateway.

**Controller**: `getCashfreeRefund` in `src/controllers/cashfreeController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Initiates a direct money payout/transfer to a verified beneficiary via Cashfree Payouts API.

**Controller**: `createCashfreePayout` in `src/controllers/cashfreeController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Retrieves recent Cashfree payouts created by administrators (sorted newest first, up to 100 records).

**Controller**: `listCashfreePayouts` in `src/controllers/cashfreeController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Fetches current status of a specific transfer from Cashfree Payouts API and updates internal DB records.

**Controller**: `getCashfreePayout` in `src/controllers/cashfreeController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Retries a previously failed, rejected, or reversed payout using the original transfer details.

**Controller**: `retryCashfreePayout` in `src/controllers/cashfreeController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Lists all referral reward ledger records (`status: 'CREDITED'`, `payoutStatus: 'PENDING'`) awaiting manual offline bank/UPI payout. Enriches records with referrer's userCode, mobile, wallet balance, and verified referral count.

**Controller**: `listPendingManualPayouts` in `src/referral/referral.controller.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Marks a referral reward payout as settled (`payoutStatus: 'PAID'`) after the administrator manually completes bank/UPI payment.

**Controller**: `markPayoutPaid` in `src/referral/referral.controller.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Admin recovery endpoint to manually evaluate, gate, and credit referral rewards for a successful subscription payment.

**Controller**: `reprocessPaymentReward` in `src/referral/referral.controller.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Admin endpoint to reverse an earlier credited referral reward (and debit the referrer's wallet) when the underlying subscription payment is refunded.

**Controller**: `reverseReward` in `src/referral/referral.controller.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Sends targeted push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) based on criteria (`userType`, `skills`, `businessTypes`, `userIds`, `excludeUserIds`) and creates database notification records. Also available at `/api/firebase/send`.

**Controller**: `sendFCMNotification` in `src/controllers/fcmController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Sends a direct push notification to all active devices of a single specified user and records an in-app Notification. Also available at `/api/firebase/send-to-user`.

**Controller**: `sendFCMToUser` in `src/controllers/fcmController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Returns stats on total users with registered device tokens and the 10 most recent general notifications. Also available at `/api/firebase/stats`.

**Controller**: `getFCMStats` in `src/controllers/fcmController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

item.name: Get Users with FCM Device Tokens (Admin)

request.description:
Returns list of all users who have active FCM device tokens registered on the platform. Also available at `/api/firebase/token-users`.

**Controller**: `getTokenUsers` in `src/controllers/fcmController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

query.description: Filter by status: open | in_progress | closed

request.description:
Fetches all support tickets with status filtering and pagination.

**Controller**: `getAllTicketsAdmin` in `src/controllers/ticketController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Retrieves comprehensive support ticket details including user contact info, messages, attachments, status, and latest admin note.

**Controller**: `getTicketById` in `src/controllers/ticketController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Updates ticket status (`open`, `in_progress`, `closed`) and appends an administrative resolution note. Setting status to `closed` automatically sets `resolvedAt`.

**Controller**: `updateTicketStatus` in `src/controllers/ticketController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

query.description: Filter by status: new | in_progress | resolved | closed
Filter by priority: low | medium | high | urgent
Filter by type: general | support | feedback | complaint | partnership | business

request.description:
Lists all user inquiries submitted via web/app with filtering by status, priority, and inquiry type.

**Controller**: `getAllInquiries` in `src/controllers/inquiryController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`)

Aggregates total inquiry counts grouped by status and by inquiry type.

**Controller**: `getInquiryStats` in `src/controllers/inquiryController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`)

Retrieves single inquiry details by ID with populated user, assigned admin, and responder information.

**Controller**: `getInquiryById` in `src/controllers/inquiryController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`)

Updates inquiry status (`new`, `in_progress`, `resolved`, `closed`), priority, administrative notes, or records an official resolution response message.

**Controller**: `updateInquiry` in `src/controllers/inquiryController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`)

Permanently deletes an inquiry record from the database.

**Controller**: `deleteInquiry` in `src/controllers/inquiryController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`)

Retrieves all mobile banners (visible and hidden) with creator and updater admin details.

**Controller**: `getAllMobileBanners` in `src/controllers/publicController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Creates a new promotional banner for the mobile app home screen. If `visible` is set to `true`, all other banners are automatically deactivated.

**Controller**: `createMobileBanner` in `src/controllers/publicController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Updates an existing mobile banner's title, image, deep link, context, or visibility status.

**Controller**: `updateMobileBanner` in `src/controllers/publicController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)

Deletes a mobile banner record by ID.

**Controller**: `deleteMobileBanner` in `src/controllers/publicController.js`
**Auth**: Bearer Token (`authenticateToken`, `isAdmin`)
